metadata.title: WR-VIII: The Cosmological Fibre: Universes Compatible with Our Universe Today — Distance responses, curvature completion and global ambiguity (v0.2)
metadata.description:
Bilingual preprint v0.2: English article and complete Russian translation in one deposit package. On a finite redshift interval, a calibrated transverse-distance profile D in C²[0,Z], D(0)=0 and D′>0 throughout admits an explicit first-branch FLRW curvature/positive-expansion completion family. Independently calibrated positive expansion-rate responses refine or exclude it. Free supernova and BAO calibration scales retain a joint scale symmetry. An exact polynomial family gives finite inversion, rank and deterministic interval certificates for a stipulated joint Cartesian box. Restricted classical patch protocols admit Euclidean/large-torus spatial lifts, and an additionally smooth kinematic baseline admits distinct future extensions.

Полный русский перевод включён в тот же комплект. Версия v0.2 учитывает замечания автоматизированного предпубликационного аудита: уточнены условия аннотации, область формулы звёздных величин, совместные интервальные ограничения, локальная метрика тора и дополнительная гладкость будущего. Все примеры и иллюстрации аналитические или синтетические.

Standard distance/curvature identities and ruler/candle/clock calibration prior art are attributed. The automated audit is not independent external scientific peer review. No observational fit, new gravity theory, fixed-matter admissibility, exhaustive priority certification or identification of the actual Universe is claimed. Mathematical compatibility is conditional on the declared kinematic carrier. Content and original analytic figures: CC BY 4.0. Executable scripts and HTML code: MIT.
